unresolvedLimitations: No local lower-limb teacher slides, notes or transcript were found; all lower-limb concepts remain book-extension.
The upper-limb transcripts explicitly defer a later hand session, but that teacher source was not found; hand detail remains book-extension.
The Gray's PDF text map is malformed, so cited pages were checked by rendering and local OCR; page locators retain the verified printed-to-local offset of +12 in the limb chapters.
The seven SRT files duplicate the seven TXT transcripts and were inventoried but not counted as independent evidence.
No official examination blueprint or weighting source was available; the checklist itself warns that limb anatomy is Semester 1 carryover.
